name: Shanghai Runda Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Runda Medical Technology Co., Ltd. provides medical laboratory services primarily in China. It provides laboratory design/renovation, laboratory standardization, and information management system services; various customized laboratory management solutions; professional technical services; and specialized logistic services. The company also engages in the research and development, manufacturing, sale, and service of in vitro diagnostic products, including reagents and other consumables.
